info.name: WorkDesk API
info.description:
WorkDesk helpdesk and service-request API (Next.js route handlers).

**Setup**
1. Import this collection and one environment file, then select the environment.
2. Seed the demo data: `SEED_DEMO=true npm run prisma:seed`.
3. Run folder `00 Setup` once: it logs in the five demo personas and stores their tokens.
4. Run the folders in order (right-click the collection, Run), or send requests one by one. The folders are written as one connected story: create role, assign it, change its permissions, run a ticket through its lifecycle, deactivate a user.

Every request states the permission it needs and who it runs as. Requests that are expected to be refused (401/403/404/409) assert exactly that, so a green run proves the security rules too.

**Notes**
- Folder `07 Attachments` needs a file and is meant to be run by hand.
- Access tokens last 15 minutes; if a request returns 401 `TOKEN_EXPIRED`, re-run `00 Setup`.
- The refresh cookie is HttpOnly and SameSite=Strict, scoped to `/api/auth`. With `COOKIE_SECURE=true` Postman will only send it over https.
- Login is limited to 10 per minute per IP, forgot-password to 3 per 15 minutes.

exec: if (!pm.environment.get('baseUrl')) { console.warn('No environment selected: pick WorkDesk Local in the top right.'); }
// Every API reply uses { success, message, data?, code?, details? }.
try { const c = pm.response.json().code; if (c === 'TOKEN_EXPIRED') console.warn('Access token expired: re-run folder 00 Setup (or POST /api/auth/refresh).'); } catch (e) {}
if (pm.response.code >= 500) { pm.test('no server errors', () => pm.expect.fail('Got ' + pm.response.code)); }

request.description:
**Public** (no bearer token)

**Expected:** 200

Needs the `refresh_token` cookie from a login. Rotation: the old cookie value is single-use; replaying it later revokes the session (`auth.refresh_reuse_detected`). Browser-style `Origin` headers other than the configured frontend are rejected with 403.

**Runs as:** System Administrator (`{{tokenAdmin}}`)

**Expected:** 422

A successful change revokes every session of the user, so this collection only demonstrates the refusal.

**Public** (no bearer token)

**Expected:** 202

Same answer whether or not the email exists. Limited to 3 per 15 minutes per IP and per email. In development the reset link is printed in the server log.

request.description:
**Permission:** `tickets.create`

**Runs as:** Employee (`{{tokenEmployee}}`)

**Expected:** 201

Always starts in PENDING_REVIEW. Unknown body fields (`status`, `requesterId` ...) are rejected with 400. A category from another department is 422.

**Runs as:** Employee (`{{tokenEmployee}}`)

**Expected:** 200

Search accepts a title fragment or a reference such as `WD-2026-000042`. `status` and `priority` take comma lists. The list is always clipped to your scope.

**Runs as:** Support Manager (IT) (`{{tokenManager}}`)

**Expected:** 409

Only PENDING_REVIEW can be accepted.

request.description:
**Permission:** `tickets.view_own` + scope

**Runs as:** Employee (`{{tokenEmployee}}`)

**Expected:** 201

Choose a file in the `file` field. Allowed: PNG, JPEG, PDF, plain text, max 5 MB, up to 10 per ticket. The type is detected from the file content, so a renamed `.exe` is refused with 415. `commentId` must be one of your own comments on this ticket.

**Runs as:** Auditor (read-only) (`{{tokenAuditor}}`)

**Expected:** 200, 404

Auditors can read tickets, so this succeeds for them; use an Employee who is not the requester to see the 404.

**Runs as:** Employee (`{{tokenEmployee}}`)

**Expected:** 204

Uploader, or a user holding `tickets.delete`.

**Permission:** `tickets.view_department`

**Runs as:** Support Manager (IT) (`{{tokenManager}}`)

**Expected:** 200

Only departments you manage; another department's id answers 404.

**Runs as:** Auditor (read-only) (`{{tokenAuditor}}`)

**Expected:** 200

Computed over the tickets the caller may see. Defaults to the last 30 days. `from`/`to` are optional.

**Permission:** `reports.view`

**Runs as:** Auditor (read-only) (`{{tokenAuditor}}`)
